popup.title: Köpenick to Neukölln
popup.body:
The southeastern approach brought fighting through the Spree-side districts while other Soviet armies pressed toward central Berlin.

Use the river crossings to link Köpenick, Treptow and Neukölln. Hold both bridge approaches before committing the next assault group.

Objective: Capture the southeastern district objectives.

Scaled RTS adaptation: terrain, distances, forces and battle time are compressed. Generic unit classes represent formations; supplied assembly areas are gameplay logistics anchors.

popup.title: Local counterattack
popup.body: Enemy reserves are approaching the active sector. Keep a defense group behind your assault and protect your supply route.

popup.title: Reserves available
popup.body: A fresh infantry reserve reaches your supplied assembly area. Use it to support the next objective or defend your rear.
